edits.sketch: rule 17 (was: 'Use the object form when the Verified Facts section above lists facts: ...') becomes: 'When the Verified Facts section above lists facts, EVERY section entry on EVERY page must be the object form with an explicit "facts" key - including pages you are carrying over unchanged; a plain-string entry means you have not decided that section. ... Decide ownership for every fact in the roster: a fact left out of every list is stated nowhere on the site, so leave one out only deliberately. ... "facts": [] marks a section that deliberately states no verified facts (the right value for most hero, call-to-action and navigation sections).' Roster block sentence gains 'for EVERY section on EVERY page - including pages carried over unchanged'. Example sections array: ["hero", {...}, "testimonials", ...] -> [{"name": "hero", "facts": []}, {"name": "features", "facts": ["F1-example-id"]}, {"name": "testimonials", "facts": []}, {"name": "call-to-action", "facts": []}]
